story:
SpringLake Pools & Masonry is a family-owned company working out of Dallas, Pennsylvania, building custom concrete pools, spas and outdoor living spaces across the Back Mountain and the Wyoming Valley.

We are a recognised leader in the swimming pool and outdoor living industry, and we have served customers who wanted to make an informed, confident decision that ends in a backyard as functional as it is innovative. Choosing a builder with the right experience is essential to a well-crafted outdoor living space. When you are ready to invest in yours, everything rides on who does the work — custom design and quality construction are the obvious priorities, but you also want a partner who guides you through the process, keeps you informed, and sticks to your budget.

We are not a corporation running jobs out of another county. We know every inch of Luzerne County soil, from the rocky terrain near Harvey's Lake to the clay deposits in Back Mountain. Our kids go to Dallas School District. We shop at Gerrity's. We know which streets flood during the spring melt and which neighbourhoods have the trickiest utility lines.

That local knowledge shows up in the work. Gunite shells engineered for a climate that swings from 90°F summers to -10°F winters. Excavation planned around what is actually under your yard. Masonry — coping, decks, retaining walls, fire pits, water features and outdoor kitchens — handled by our own crew rather than subcontracted out. And once the pool is finished, the same company renovates it, repairs it, and opens and closes it every season.

From your first design consult to the champagne toast at completion, we communicate clearly, interface often, and dedicate our time to the details. That is the whole job.
